d: Long, flowing honey-blonde hair with sweeping bangs and a voluminous texture frames a youthful, mature face with focused, golden-amber eyes. The build is curvaceous with a large bust and slender limbs. The outfit consists of a navy blue and white nautical-style ensemble featuring a tied-front top, a white bodice with the number "61" on the hip, and a short pleated navy and white striped skirt secured by a brown belt with a golden emblem. Signature details include a grey metallic choker, matching grey arm sleeves, and large mechanical battleship rigging equipped with grey naval cannons positioned behind the back.
